svg.title: Requirement ledger
svg.desc: Brief requirement: Observation budgets and deltas, Planned proof: Full/delta reconstruction, byte/token accounting, stale baseline rejection; Brief requirement: Cross-origin frames, virtualized interfaces, canvas, Planned proof: Separate fixture journeys; report unsupported capabilities explicitly until implemented; Brief requirement: Workflow replay, model assistance and recovery, Planned proof: Deterministic replay, explicit optional repair hook, checkpoint interruption tests; Brief requirement: Task resource profiles and fallback, Planned proof: Tab preset persists on success until explicitly changed; readiness-failure fallback restores prior rules, with no automatic task-end restore; Brief requirement: On-demand inspector and takeover, Planned proof: Live task/queue/resource view plus existing handoff journey; Brief requirement: Persistent SDKs with cancellation and deadlines, Planned proof: Python, TypeScript, Swift live socket tests; Brief requirement: Bounded redacted failure bundles, Planned proof: Bundle allowlist, size limit and injected secret-field checks; Brief requirement: Optional streaming/recording/tracing, Planned proof: Explicit start/stop and no capture when unused
